SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

Central I.B. Station
REPORT
Date May 11th 1929

Subject (in full) Mr. Boleslaw Sawicki alias Boris Sawicki, alias Saviski.

Made by D.S. Ovsianikoff Forwarded by Jhn Robertson C.D.I.

Sir,

With reference to the attached file, inquiries go to show that the S.S. "Kaga Maru" of the Nippon Yusen Kaisha Company arrived in Hongkong from Australia on April 18 and at Nagasaki, Japan on April 23. In view of the fact that the "Kaga Maru" does not call at Shanghai, local office of the N.Y.K. has no record of its passengers. Since April 18th no ships of the N.Y.K/ Line have arrived in Shanghai from Hongkong and it is presumed that Boleslaw Sawicki, alias Boris Sawicki, alias Saviski proceeded direct to Harbin from Nagasaki via Moji. It is also probable that he changed ships in Hongkong and arrive in Shanghai under an assumed name but all efforts to trace him from the description given have been unsuccessful.

N.R.
11/5/29.

V. Ovsianikoff
D. S.

A/D.C.I. Reply on these lines
for signature of Capt Martin
11/5: Kao

报告
日期 1929年5月11日

事由（全称） Boleslaw Sawicki先生，又名 Boris Sawicki，又名 Saviski。

呈报人 D.S. Ovsianikoff 转呈人 Jhn Robertson C.D.I.

敬启者，

关于附件档案，经查询显示，日本邮船会社（Nippon Yusen Kaisha Company）的“加贺丸”号（S.S. "Kaga Maru"）轮船于4月18日从澳大利亚抵达香港，并于4月23日抵达日本长崎。鉴于“加贺丸”号不靠泊上海，日本邮船会社上海办事处没有该船乘客的记录。自4月18日以来，没有日本邮船会社航线的船只从香港抵达上海，据推测，Boleslaw Sawicki（又名 Boris Sawicki，又名 Saviski）已从长崎经门司直接前往哈尔滨。他也有可能在香港换船并以化名抵达上海，但根据所提供的体貌特征进行追踪的所有努力均未成功。

N.R.
1929年5月11日。

V. Ovsianikoff
侦探副巡长（D. S.）

请按此思路拟复
供 Martin 警司签署

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. Q. D. 184
Date 14. 5. 29

May 13th 29

My dear Jamieson,

Re Boleslaw Jawicki alias Boris Sawicki
alias Javiaki.

With reference to your letter of April 23,
regarding the above individual's expected arrival in
Shanghai on board the s.s. "Kaga Maru", enquiries show
that this vessel arrived in Hongkong on April 18 and
proceeded direct to Nagasaki, omitting Shanghai, and the
local offices of the N.Y.K. have no record of its passengers.
Every effort has been made to trace this individual
by the description given, as it was thought he might have
come to Shanghai under an assumed name, but without result,
and it seems probable that he proceeded direct to Harbin
from Nagasaki via Moji, without touching Shanghai.

Yours sincerely,

(Sd) R.M.J. Martin.

E. G. Jamieson, Esq., C.B.E.
H.B.M. Consulate General,
Shanghai.

Rory

编号 I. Q. D. 184
日期 1929年5月14日

1929年5月13日

亲爱的 Jamieson：

关于 Boleslaw Jawicki，又名 Boris Sawicki，又名 Javiaki。

关于您4月23日的来信，提及上述人员预计乘坐“加贺丸”号轮船抵达上海一事，经查，该船于4月18日抵达香港，随后直接前往长崎，未停靠上海，且日本邮船会社当地办事处没有该船乘客的记录。
已尽一切努力根据所提供的体貌特征追踪此人，因为认为他可能以化名来到上海，但毫无结果，看来他很可能已从长崎经门司直接前往哈尔滨，未经过上海。

此致
敬礼，

（签名） R.M.J. Martin.

E. G. Jamieson 先生，大英帝国勋章获得者（C.B.E.）
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

Rory
